candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: LIDAR Vegetation Object Model (VOM)
verified_facts: The VOM is derived from EA National LiDAR Programme 1m elevation data plus OS mapping and Sentinel-2 imagery.
Each raster pixel represents vegetation canopy-top height above ground for classified vegetation objects above 2.5m.
Production is fully automated with no manual QC/editing beyond visual checks, and EA notes possible misclassifications.
VOM is delivered as 5km GeoTIFF tiles and is a derived product.
semantic_limits: Canopy height above ground is not bare-earth terrain elevation and must never replace the SHA-bound DTM values used for parcel height difference.

candidates.publisher: Forestry Commission / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: National Trees Outside Woodland Map
verified_facts: The map identifies canopy cover over 3m tall and 5m2 outside the National Forest Inventory.
It is derived from the EA VOM, National LiDAR Survey and Sentinel-2 imagery using automated spatial algorithms.
The product has been assessed with ground truth but still documents possible object misclassification.
semantic_limits: A classified tree-canopy vector is contextual land-cover evidence, not a direct parcel ground-elevation measurement or legal-boundary source.
